supersedes.reason: The first live clean replay exposed a recorded task Fail caused solely by DNS resolution. The original analysis treated every Fail as a repair opportunity despite the preregistered infrastructure censor rule.

mechanism_trace_policy.first_replay: first task-valid executed replay after censoring
mechanism_trace_policy.repair_opportunity: first task-valid replay is Fail or Unknown
mechanism_trace_policy.activated_repair: later task-valid replay certifies a different canonical program
mechanism_trace_policy.repair_success: activated repair followed by Official Pass

symmetric_scope: The same infrastructure censor rule applies to A, B, and C. A B-arm infrastructure-censored sole replay requires an independently frozen replacement because B cannot execute a second replay.
